  SELECT _ProductID,
         MAX(CAST(REPLACE("Unit Price", ',', '') AS REAL) - CAST(REPLACE("Unit Cost", ',', '') AS REAL)) AS profit
  FROM "Sales Orders"
  GROUP BY _ProductID
), fourth_product AS (
  SELECT _ProductID
  FROM product_profits
  ORDER BY profit DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT sl.Latitude, sl.Longitude
FROM "Sales Orders" so

WITH margins AS (
  SELECT _ProductID,
         MAX(CAST(REPLACE("Unit Price", ',', '') AS REAL) - CAST(REPLACE("Unit Cost", ',', '') AS REAL)) AS profit
  FROM "Sales Orders"
  GROUP BY _ProductID
), ranked AS (
  SELECT _ProductID, profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY profit DESC) AS rnk
  FROM margins
)

FROM ranked r
JOIN "Sales Orders" so ON so._ProductID = r._ProductID
JOIN "Store Locations" sl ON sl.StoreID = so._StoreID
WHERE r.rnk = 4
ORDER BY sl.Latitude, sl.Longitude;
